title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am going to start a new business with my friend both have agreed to invest 50% amount by each and to share the profit in the same percentage 2328 views Q. Doing business of selling food only of restaurants which sell food and also alcohol. 1993 views Q. After retirement I invested my PF amount in a business looked after by my sister-in-law in Australia. She deals with properties and owns many properties and Estates and get rent from them. She must have taken bank loans to purchase the properties and must have paid bank interest also. She suggested to me to invest my amount in her business and she would give me 14% profit for the first year. Each year the profit percentage changes. For last year I got about 18% profit. It is also agreed that if she incur losses, the losses will be shared by me also. Further she said after deducting all the maintenance expenses etc., the profit will be calculated each year. It was also agreed that whenever I want I can discontinue the business with her and I will get back my whole invested amount. Could you tell me with the above conditions the profit what I am getting is Halal ? Suppose I discontinue the business with her and if I get back my whole amount, should I pay the Zakath for the previous years when the amount was in her possession or should I pay the Zakath once the amount come to me and remain with me for one full year? Right now I pay the Zakath for the profit amount which remains with me unused/surplus for one year. 1595 views Q. Is Currency Trading is Halal? if Halal! currency trading in future that is buy today sell tomorrow or day after is Halal? the possibilities of profit in currency trading only on future that is taking to next day or two. I learned from dfferent articles that taking to the future is Haram or Najayaz. But sorry to say more risky and more benefficial in the friction of seconds. Kindly write in detail please. 7241 views Q. Property Buy Back 2257 views Q. I am borrowing Rs 100000 from a person to invest in a land and after selling it I will give Rs 5-6 thousand as profit to that person within a period of three months. Is it allowable 1967 views Q. Is it permissible to take any items on instalments and paying more money to that item.because its not possible for me to pay the whole amount at a time, please reply. 2075 views Q. I have 21 years old son from my first marriage, who lives with me and goes to college. My first husband has passed away. I have married to a married man has his own family. He lives with his family, but comes every week. I had a business from my first marriage and now my husband runs it. So far I have worked and paid all the bills. Now I am not working from four months, my husband says that what ever I made belongs to him. He denies giving it to my son. Is this right by Islamic way? Please send me your fatwa for this situation. May Allah reward you for this? 2519 views Q. Commission,Bribe in Business 2820 views Q. doing business with FIXED MONTHLY INCOME is haram ? 10736 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 40639 Country: India Title: I am borrowing Rs 100000 from a person to invest in a land and after selling it I will give Rs 5-6 thousand as profit to that person within a period of three months. Is it allowable Question: I am borrowing Rs 100000 from a person to invest in a land and after selling it I will give Rs 5-6 thousand as profit to that person within a period of three months. Is it allowable? Answer ID: 40639 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1173/757/H=1433) It is not allowed as it is interest which is haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
